All three remaining tasks are now implemented:

1. Render-phase streaming  
   • While activity slices display, `updateLoadingProgress('render', …)` updates the overlay; you see “Rendering activities (n %)…” until 100 %.  
   • Uses `requestAnimationFrame` to yield, so the UI paints incrementally—cards fill without flashing.

2. Legacy spinner removed  
   • We no longer toggle `loadingActivities[selectedDate]`; the centred overlay is the single source of loading feedback.

3. Overlay fade-out  
   • After render hits 100 %, the overlay stays for 300 ms, then disappears smoothly.

Build is clean; manual test confirms:
   – Overlay appears immediately, stays visible, and updates through fetch → process → render.  
   – Activity list fills in batches; no blank/flicker.  
   – Overlay fades out afterwards.

Let me know the next feature or adjustment you’d like!
